                                                                                                                          EASA AD No.: 2025-0159R1

                                                                  Airworthiness Directive
                                                                  AD No.: 2025-0159R1
                                                                  Issued:          19 October 2026

         Design Approval Holder’s Name:                                                    Type/Model designation(s):
         AIRBUS HELICOPTERS                                                                AS 350, AS 355, EC 120 and EC 130
                                                                                           helicopters

         Effective Date:                 Revision 01: 26 October 2026
         Foreign AD:                     Not applicable
         Revison:                        This AD revises EASA AD 2025-0159 dated 24 July 2025.

         Applicability:
         AS 350 B, AS 350 BA, AS 350 BB, AS 350 B1, AS 350 B2, AS 350 B3, AS 350 D, EC 120 B, EC 130 B4, AS
         355 E, AS 355 F, AS 355 F1, AS 355 F2, AS 355 N and AS 355 NP helicopters, all serial numbers (s/n)
         on which modification 0720257 has not been embodied, except EC 120 B helicopters having s/n
         1674 and a s/n from 1678 until 1700 inclusive.
